modules.name: minisvc.config
modules.purpose: Defines immutable Settings and translates MINISVC_DB/MINISVC_READONLY environment values into runtime configuration.

modules.name: minisvc.models
modules.purpose: Defines the in-memory Order domain record.

modules.name: minisvc.audit
modules.purpose: Builds order event dictionaries for create/read responses; it does not persist them.

modules.name: minisvc.storage.repo
modules.purpose: SQLite-backed repository for initializing the orders schema and saving/fetching Order records.

modules.name: minisvc.api.handlers
modules.purpose: Application handlers that convert request payloads or IDs into order responses and invoke the repository/audit formatter.

modules.name: minisvc.api.routes
modules.purpose: HTTP adapter that binds POST and GET order routes to the application handlers.

modules.name: minisvc.cli
modules.purpose: CLI bootstrap that loads settings, constructs the repository, initializes SQLite schema, and reports readiness.

entry_points.behavior: Loads environment settings, initializes the repository schema, prints readiness, returns 0.
Registers POST /orders and GET /orders/<order_id> callbacks on the supplied app.
Builds and saves an Order from a payload, then returns a created response and formatted event.
Reads an order by ID and returns either missing or ok response plus a formatted event.

key_functions.role: Reads MINISVC_DB (default orders.sqlite) and parses MINISVC_READONLY == "1" into Settings.
CLI startup orchestration; creates OrderRepository and calls init_schema.
Stores the configured database path as a pathlib.Path.
Creates the orders table if absent using a SQLite connection context manager.
Inserts an Order into SQLite; no retry or readonly check is present.
Parameterized lookup by order_id; returns Order or None.
Binds HTTP methods/paths to callbacks that call handlers.
Constructs Order, coerces total_cents with int(), saves it, and formats a response event.
Retrieves an order and returns missing/ok response shapes.
Returns an in-memory order event dictionary; no database write.

runtime_flows.name: CLI startup
steps: repo.init_schema() opens SQLite and creates orders if absent
readiness line is printed and main returns 0

runtime_flows.name: HTTP create-order
steps: minisvc.api.handlers:create_order reads order_id, customer, and total_cents
Order is instantiated; total_cents is coerced with int()
repo.save(order) inserts into the orders table
handler returns status, order_id, and event; no audit-table persistence occurs
